nodes.label: GAN-43: isSubmitting loading state on outlet create/edit submit buttons
nodes.rationale: Prevent double submit by disabling/loading the Save button via PrimeVue :loading prop bound to isSubmitting, set true on valid form submit and false in a finally block regardless of success/failure.

nodes.label: GAN-52: Fix breadcrumb routes for product-categories/product-lists edit & detail pages
nodes.rationale: Edit/Detail breadcrumb previously pointed to routes without id (404) or to wrong route (/create); fix sets isActive true and removes route param on leaf breadcrumb items, while parent-level breadcrumbs route back to tab-specific query params.
nodes.norm_label: gan-52: fix breadcrumb routes for product-categories/product-lists edit & detail pages

nodes.label: Non-blocking finding: detail kategori route uses [CREATE] permission instead of [READ]
nodes.rationale: Pre-existing bug, out of scope for GAN-52, flagged for separate fix to align with product-lists module convention using [READ] for detail views.
nodes.norm_label: non-blocking finding: detail kategori route uses [create] permission instead of [read]

nodes.label: HOTFIX-RBAC-CROSS-TENANT: outlet-merchant ownership validation on role assign/revoke
nodes.rationale: assignRoleToUser and revokeRoleFromUser did not validate that dto.outlet_id belonged to the caller's merchant, enabling cross-tenant role manipulation; fixed with assertOutletBelongsToMerchant helper distinguishing NotFoundException (outlet missing) vs ForbiddenException (outlet belongs to different merchant). Fix scoped to service layer inline rather than a generic guard-level decorator to minimize blast radius across many endpoints.
nodes.norm_label: hotfix-rbac-cross-tenant: outlet-merchant ownership validation on role assign/revoke

nodes.label: Follow-up needed: getUserRoles endpoint has commented permission guard + no merchant/outlet filter (cross-tenant read)
nodes.rationale: Different vulnerability class (cross-tenant read vs write) than the hotfixed endpoints; needs separate ticket to uncomment @RequirePermission('role.read') and add merchant/outlet scoping validation.
nodes.norm_label: follow-up needed: getuserroles endpoint has commented permission guard + no merchant/outlet filter (cross-tenant read)

nodes.label: Architectural finding: roles/permissions tables are global (no merchant_id) despite multi-tenant product
nodes.rationale: assignPermissionToRole/revokePermissionFromRole operate on global roles/permissions tables, verified not vulnerable to the same outlet_id-from-body issue since there's no merchant scoping concept there; noted as architecture debt, not urgent bug.
nodes.norm_label: architectural finding: roles/permissions tables are global (no merchant_id) despite multi-tenant product

nodes.label: PROD-101: Fix stock indicator color logic on product list/detail pages
nodes.rationale: Qty column incorrectly showed primary color whenever min_stock was set (>0) regardless of actual stock level; fix requires warning only when stock_qty <= min_stock AND min_stock > 0, and adds a Low Stock Tag on the detail page.
nodes.norm_label: prod-101: fix stock indicator color logic on product list/detail pages

nodes.label: PROD-102: Backend-driven search + category filter on product list
nodes.rationale: Search input existed but only did console.log, no backend wiring; category filter dropdown needed using existing getActiveCategories(); requires debounce 300ms, AND-combination of search+category as query params, pagination preserves active filters, and filter changes reset page to 1.
nodes.norm_label: prod-102: backend-driven search + category filter on product list

nodes.label: PROD-102 attempt 1 typecheck failure: TS2698 spread on inferred-null form.value.category_id
nodes.rationale: vue-tsc -b failed because ref() inferred type null for category_id; fixed by explicit ref<{ search: string; category_id: string | null }> typing on attempt 2.
nodes.norm_label: prod-102 attempt 1 typecheck failure: ts2698 spread on inferred-null form.value.category_id

nodes.label: PIV Level 2: QA gate / Reviewer gate retry (max 1x each, independent counters)
nodes.rationale: Counters are independent local `let` variables per gate, fresh each job run via scoping, not shared budget with Level 1 or Level 3; when exhausted the pipeline returns cleanly (not throws) and posts a Linear comment.

nodes.label: PIV Level 3: BullMQ job/queue retry (attempts: 3, infra failures only)
nodes.rationale: Only triggers on thrown exceptions/crashes (network timeout, process crash); gate-exhausted quality failures use `return` deliberately so BullMQ does not treat them as job failures and does not retry the whole pipeline.

nodes.label: ADR-001: Multi-Tenant Data Scoping via Auth-Derived merchant_id
nodes.rationale: Every DB query scoping tenant data must derive merchant_id from JWT via @CurrentUser(), never from client input, to prevent cross-tenant data leakage; DB-level row security not supported in MySQL without third-party tooling.
nodes.norm_label: adr-001: multi-tenant data scoping via auth-derived merchant_id

nodes.label: ADR-002: DB-First Schema Convention
nodes.rationale: Chosen because MySQL schema predates Prisma, SQL readability requires snake_case parity, and operational tooling (workbench/dump files) uses DB column names; UUID PKs prevent enumeration attacks; mandatory @@index prevents full table scans since MySQL doesn't auto-index FKs.

nodes.label: StockLogsQueryDto validation fix
nodes.rationale: GET /stock/logs mixed @Query('product_id') with @Query() pagination:PaginationDto, and ValidationPipe's forbidNonWhitelisted:true rejected product_id. Fixed by a StockLogsQueryDto extends PaginationDto with product_id field, consolidating into a single @Query() decorator.

nodes.label: Product-edit-page UI/validation pattern
nodes.rationale: Reference UI pattern from src/modules/product/pages/edit.vue: UiCard + Form + zodResolver + UiFormGroup + Message + bottom action buttons with border-top, max-w-2xl centered layout.

nodes.label: ADR-001 Multi-tenant data scoping via auth
nodes.rationale: merchant_id must always come from @CurrentUser('merchant_id'), never from DTO/body/query; every tenant-scoped Prisma query requires where: { merchant_id }.
nodes.norm_label: adr-001 multi-tenant data scoping via auth

nodes.label: ADR-002 DB-first schema convention
nodes.rationale: Schema generated from existing MySQL database into Prisma (DB-first) rather than Prisma-first, since MySQL schema predated Prisma adoption; models/fields use snake_case.

nodes.label: ADR-004 DTO inheritance for query params
nodes.rationale: Endpoints with pagination+filter must use a single @Query() query: XxxQueryDto extending PaginationDto instead of mixing @Query('field') with a bare @Query().
nodes.norm_label: adr-004 dto inheritance for query params

nodes.label: file-upload-to-s3 design.md
nodes.rationale: S3-compatible object storage chosen over local disk or base64-in-DB for scalability across multi-outlet deployments; pre-signed URLs chosen over public bucket for security; database metadata table (uploads) chosen for queryability/RBAC/audit since S3 itself has no query capability.

nodes.label: add-image-uploads-to-features design.md
nodes.rationale: Two-step upload (POST /uploads then PATCH /:id/image or /avatar) reused from the existing product pattern rather than duplicating multer/storage logic per module; FK columns (logo_upload_id/avatar_upload_id) added alongside legacy logo/avatar text columns for backward compatibility rather than removing the text columns; shared useFileUpload composable and UiFileUpload component created to avoid duplicated inline upload logic across merchant/outlet/user/profile pages.
